Applicability. Direct Worker engagement preserves the same sufficient intake,
work-result refinement, closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting

concepts.definition: Executive is the coordinated branch's activation, result-consumption and bounded disposition frame. It acts within existing authority; its name does not confer semantic, operation or acceptance authority.

records the effect on the current promotion boundary, and acts on exactly one

concepts.definition: Worker is the bounded work frame that returns work-result refinement and transition evidence to its declared consumer. Completed coordinated work returns to Executive; interruption or actor loss remains unreturned work.

concepts.definition: Reviewer returns an RF-012 closed result with exact subject, population, independence, assurance-path and invalidation coordinates, plus separately carried findings, counterexamples, adjacent observations and re-entry information. Reviewer returns [RF-012's closed result](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-012-closed-results)

concepts.definition: Handoff Projection transports a bound source contract to a named consuming task using Faithful projection. concepts.definition: Ticket Method is a work-carrier member binding the shared transformation library to durable work identity, admission, recording and closure. Tickets, sprints and the default file layout are this member's

Sprints are not constitutional authority. They operate under `SPEC_METHOD.md`

Assurance/source closure includes relied-on consumers, fixtures, proof scripts, generators, mutations and tooling; obsolete assurance consumers must neither falsely supply closure evidence nor reintroduce removed paths. A retained obsolete test/proof consumer capable of either remains an assurance defect.

Default unit evidence size/strategy is proportional to internal combinatorial complexity. Shared fixtures, tools, observations, interpretations and received contributions remain dependence information. Conjunction preserves original failures and missing claims; required independent assessment keeps separate authorship rules.

constraints.statement: Acquire and Evaluate bind two distinct inputs: owner-issued subject and independently derived oracle. Faithful projection governs observation transport. Generic byte/digest/order/equality/membership/completeness/conjunction checks may evaluate owner evidence but may not mint carriers, select current history or authoritative paths, interpret owner lifecycle/admission meaning, or supply runtime fallback. Assertions state actual predicate, scope and justified requirement/refinement relation; narrower assertions establish only supported conclusions. Select the required acceptable relation without assuming valid outputs must be equal. Support observation acquisition, checker conformance and material-case distinctions. Missing support remains explicit on the original core predicate; pass/fail alone does not establish the broader obligation. Keep assertion provenance separate from execution provenance. A common derivation may serve a declared test family; implementation-derived checks support regression/local properties but cannot become the independent upstream oracle merely by repeating implementation answers.

Changed requirements revisit dependent expected answers through their owner; implementation/environment corrections revisit affected execution and integration. Strategy follows assurance/risk policy and total relevant selection/execution costs; broader testing remains available where impact or policy requires. Retain residual combinations and known counterexamples in the existing evidence account. No fixed full-suite cadence or new test ledger is introduced.

constraints.statement: Bind one Product outcome, independent oracle, governing requirements/design, exact source/workspace checkpoint, contracts and finite cases. Design binds participant roles, functional path, dependencies, configuration and capabilities; realized claims bind actual participants, callable selection, supported entry/exit and runnable artifact/install. At each seam include producers, consumers, transformations/effect owners, pre/postconditions, value/reference domains, lifecycle/time, supplied context, mutable subject, refusals, observations and user result. Distinguish Product, install/artifact, workspace, observation, invocation, candidate, admitted-result and evidence identities plus revisions, domain, units, cardinality, ordering, empty/null/default meaning and validity interval; equal shape/output implies no equality of meaning, provenance or authority. Existing owners retain semantic, operation, admission and reserved-decision authority; activation grants bounded evaluation, construction requires its existing exact grant, and the declared consumer disposes the closed result. Evidence includes source contracts and both sides, independent expected relations, substitution limits, and for realized claims actual request/context/response, callable/configuration identity, owner validation/effects/observations and ordinary caller outcome. Require sufficient competence/access without altering reviewed subjects and claim-relative independence. Exclude hidden context/privilege, rival truth, inferred authority, undeclared substitutes, private/test paths for ordinary claims, candidate-as-admission, fixture-as-user evidence and unsupported whole-Product/future-case claims. Each claim returns one of the five listed verdicts with evidence, coverage, causal findings and residuals; reference shared evidence once and compose mandatory claims only through declared same-basis or lawful-translation conjunction. Material contract, domain, participant, prompt/context, capability, path, configuration, translation, workspace observation, lifecycle, oracle or population change invalidates affected conclusions; valid unchanged evidence/rulings remain reusable. Qualification binds representative sensitivity/refusal cases to exact subjects, actor envelopes and independent expected relations; mechanical checks do not establish semantic/live-user qualification.

conditions: Activation selects claims from actual work applicability and states scope reasons for unselected claims.
A full end-to-end usability claim requires all four results and explicit conjunction.
exceptions: Design-only work does not acquire runtime obligations merely by using the frame and neither requires unavailable runtime evidence nor reports runtime/UAT satisfaction.

grounding.quote:
An unknown
material condition keeps its dependent claim unresolved; omission cannot
close it. A full end-to-end usability claim requires all four distinct results
and their explicit conjunction.

constraints.statement: F2/F4 preserve producer-consumer meanings and joins, F3 distinguishes subject/view, F5 requires usable participant context and F6 preserves owner grants. Complete user-path claims require material-interface, actual-selection and user-outcome evidence. Product/interface/accepted-design owners select applicability, source paths and effects. Contract sufficiency may be established by source-grounded design without runtime, retaining realizability/context uncertainty. Actual boundary congruence requires both selected sides and exchanges; design correspondence does not prove implementation behavior. Path realization requires the exact authoritative state/effect/observation path; equal output through another path is insufficient. User usability cannot be established by internal success or validator-aware fixtures. Unknown material conditions keep dependent claims unresolved. Transport, parsing, admission, semantic satisfaction, operation completion and user success are distinct.

conditions: For every material interface seam.
exceptions: Adequately declared candidate interfaces are not falsified merely by normal model refusal or inadmissible candidate output.
Mutable-subject currentness does not alter explicitly frozen authority/artifact bases or require repeating valid work merely because the actor changes.
A pure function acquires no new event lifecycle from this frame.

A normal model refusal or inadmissible candidate does not by itself falsify

constraints.statement: Reuse existing truth surfaces; records add only missing cross-interface relations, never new contract owners through schemas/prompts/adapters/indexes/tests. Bind functional input domain, producer success guarantees, consumer preconditions, permitted effects, refusals and observable exit. Direct successful handoff requires guarantees to meet preconditions; candidate emission, later admission and semantic assessment remain declared distinct stages. Supply material actor obligations/domains through actual interface/context or a lawfully resolvable exact locator; bind material LLM role, instructions, context, tools and model/transport configuration. Generic governance access cannot replace Product contracts or authorize hidden-validator inference. Deterministic owners expose owned computed facts to context/validation by reuse or proven equivalent projections; semantic actors judge within that domain, without inferring reserved rulings, eligibility, authority or admission from responses/labels. Faithful projection through serialization/parsing/normalization/adaptation preserves source/target contracts and proposed/admitted/assessed/completed, active/historical and current-validity/byte-availability distinctions. Later operations observe their actual mutable subject; pre-step snapshots do not substitute on ordinary real paths. Follow actual callable paths/effect owners to selected exits and required fresh observations; hidden fallback, state injection, manual output repair, private entry and undeclared retry cannot support ordinary real-path claims. Preserve diagnostic cause through wrappers/projections: supported frontier, originating seam, bounded field/path, expected domain/basis, mismatch and locator where available, downstream symptoms, successful work and continuation/block. Retain joint causes, alternatives, indeterminacy and redaction rules; missing required diagnostics remain named gaps. Return the smallest supported owner/re-entry; diagnosis grants no repair/retry.

exceptions: No universal live-provider requirement is added during design.

LLM UAT uses ordinary supplied context/permitted tools without private implementation knowledge or fixtures, with expectations fixed before inspecting responses and sunny plus material ordinary ambiguity/negative cases. Disclose substitutes; replayed/fabricated responses establish only narrower declared relations. Do not edit responses or silently retry to green. Steel-Thread Delivery adds no exhaustive-hardening prerequisite, quota, controller, runtime, generator, routine human approval, new ledger or automatic agent. Existing authority chooses proportionate assurance and further operations. Existing work carriers return four claim dispositions, exercised subject/path, supported mismatch, retained work, substitutions, residuals and invalidators. The result is neither acceptance nor a next-action grant.

conditions: For material computational composition or recurrence work.
exceptions: Design-only evidence establishes only the design claim.

grounding.quote:
Return an identifiable complete-path result and its evidence to the declared
decision consumer. A collection of local successes cannot replace that result.

constraints.statement: Compose selected interface claims with Operator, Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof to evaluate a complete producer-consumer path under DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md STDO-UP-019 and recurrence law. Bind fact establishment, every consumer, validity/invalidation, effects, retained alternatives and accumulated work. Evaluate equivalent computation across domain names without assuming semantic equivalence. Qualification challenges declared workload/operational assumptions while preserving independent scope, freshness and effect checks for distinct obligations. Return an identifiable whole-path result/evidence to the declared consumer; local successes cannot replace it. Actual-work claims require selected-path observations. Reuse valid unchanged results and reassess affected material path/basis/workload changes. This is bounded frame composition, not a permanent actor, extra family, per-helper review or separate ledger.

constraints.statement: While closing, freeze new iteration, review every ticket/entry against manifest, check evidence durability, walk changed surfaces against authority, classify debt and open paydown tickets for surviving debt. Treatment is distinct from compliance assessment: all obligations including required acceptance established yields satisfied and alone supports accepted's compliance meaning; demonstrated unmet obligation/authority drift yields falsified; insufficient proof/unresolved requirement/applicability/missing reason yields indeterminate; uninterpretable/contradictory subject/basis yields invalid_basis; outside scope/capability yields out_of_frame. Local paydown may concern defects or unproved obligations; repricing may concern defeated claims or unresolved changes; remove may be authorized without defect. Preserve causes/findings, conjoin deciding obligations and retain deferred evidence as debt. Separately evaluate each treatment decision against exact item/basis/mandate: lawful supported decision satisfied, demonstrated absent/unauthorized decision falsified, insufficient evidence indeterminate with scope/basis diagnoses. Raw accepted lacks no assessment by implication; raw local_paydown supplies neither ticket nor retention permission. Preserve actual/absent performance and require observed effects for removals. Domain owners supply compliance obligations; supported alternatives remain permitted without preferred implementation.
